panels.rationale: Single clinical photograph of an infant torso showing the classic defervescence eruption of roseola infantum: numerous discrete, blanching, rose-pink macules and papules centrally distributed on the trunk. Caption and in-text directly attribute the rash to roseola infantum, and the article title confirms a classic presentation. Real patient image, clear quality, no copyright concerns.

panels.rationale: Real patient clinical photograph showing a diffuse maculopapular exanthem covering the trunk, matching the caption and the vocabulary finding for roseola truncal exanthem. The article concerns disseminated HHV-6 (the etiologic agent of roseola infantum) in an adult, and the truncal exanthem is a recognized though less common presentation of HHV-6 infection, hence variant typicality. Sparse vesicular lesions are noted in the text but are not covered by the provided vocabulary, so they are listed as proposed findings. [raw subtype: truncal_maculopapular_exanthem]
